players.bio: Adil Rami (born 27 December 1985) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Troyes. Rami began his football career playing for amateur club Étoile Fréjus Saint-Raphaël, then known as ES Fréjus. Due to only playing the sport as a hobby, he spent three seasons at the club playing in the Championnat de France amateur, the fourth division of French football.
Andreas Bruus (born 16 January 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a wing-back for Ligue 1 club Troyes. He has also represented Denmark since under-16 level.
Dermane Karim (born 26 December 2003) is a Togolese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for French Ligue 1 club Lorient on loan from Belgian club Lommel SK, and the Togo national team.

Hugo Gambor (born 30 December 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for French Ligue 2 club Troyes on loan from Belgian Pro League club Gent. Born in France, he plays for the Central African Republic national team.
Hugo Fabrice Thierry Picard (born 9 May 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or left winger for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew.
Ismaël Ben Boura (born 14 August 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a left back for Ligue 2 club Troyes. Born in France, he plays for the Comoros national team.

Jérémy Le Douaron (born 21 April 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Brest. Le Douaron made his professional debut with Brest in a 4–0 Ligue 1 loss to Nîmes on 23 August 2020.

Jessy Moulin (born 13 January 1986) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Troyes. Moulin played for Saint-Étienne until 2021. He joined the reserve team in 2005, joining the first team in 2007 and being sent on loan spells to Arles, Fréjus Saint-Raphaël, and Clermont in the process. He joined Troyes in 2021.

Michel Junior Diaz (born 23 July 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Brest on loan from Troyes. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team. Club career Diaz was a youth player of Nantes. He joined Nantes' youth team in 2012, playing in the academy for ten years and winning the 2022 Under-19 league title under manager Pierre Aristouy.
Kandet Diawara (born 10 February 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger.

Patrick Beach (born 6 August 2003) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League Men club Melbourne City and the Australia national team. Beach developed his football skills playing in the NSW Football Competition.

Renaud Ripart (born 14 March 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Troyes. Ripart made his professional debut in the Coupe de la Ligue against Monaco on 7 August 2012, coming on as a substitute for Romain Thibault. On 15 July 2021, Ripart joined newly promoted Ligue 1 side Troyes for a fee of €3.3 million.
Stéphane Dumont (born 6 September 1982) is a French professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the head coach of Ligue 2 club Troyes.
Timothé Ralph Olivier Nkada Zogo (born 20 July 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Belgian Pro League side Standard Liège.

Xavier Chavalerin (born 7 March 1991) is a French professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Ligue 1 club Troyes. Career Chavalerin joined Tours in 2012 from Olympique Lyonnais. He made his Ligue 2 debut at 30 July 2012 against AS Monaco. He replaced Billy Ketkeophomphone at half-time in a 4-0 away loss. In July 2015, Chavalerin joined newly promoted team Red Star.
Youssouf Yacoub M'Changama (born 29 August 1990) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in France, he plays for the Comoros national team.
